mentions.name: shpack
mentions.description: A tool that speeds up C/C++ compiler bootstrapping, starting from a single binary of less than 1KB and reaching GCC 4.7 in 2-3 minutes on x86_64 and aarch64.
mentions.source_excerpt: Speeding up C/C++ compiler bootstrapping, starting at a single binary of <1KB. Currently it gets to GCC 4.7 in 2-3 minutes on x86_64 and aarch64: https://github.com/haampie/shpack
